mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation (event_key, open_episode_key, config_id, rule_id, symbol, market, stock_name, recipient_hash, recipient_address, sender_snapshot_json, target_fact_observation_id, target_fact_observation_key, target_source_time_epoch_ms, trade_date, signal_fingerprint, inline_analysis_id, analysis_demand_id, deadline_at, initial_subject, initial_body, initial_message_id, initial_status, initial_attempt_count, supplement_message_id, supplement_status, supplement_attempt_count, row_version) VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{openEpisodeKey}, #{configId}, #{ruleId}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{recipientHash}, #{recipientAddress}, #{senderSnapshotJson}, #{targetFactObservationId}, #{targetFactObservationKey}, #{targetSourceTimeEpochMs}, #{tradeDate}, #{signalFingerprint}, #{inlineAnalysisId}, #{analysisDemandId}, #{deadlineAt}, #{initialSubject}, #{initialBody}, #{initialMessageId}, #{initialStatus}, 0, #{supplementMessageId}, #{supplementStatus}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation WHERE event_key=#{eventKey} AND recipient_hash=#{recipientHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation WHERE initial_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','SENDING') AND (initial_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR initial_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) AND (initial_status != 'SENDING' OR initial_lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation WHERE supplement_status IN ('READY','RETRY','SENDING') AND (supplement_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR supplement_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) AND (supplement_status != 'SENDING' OR supplement_lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation WHERE analysis_demand_id=#{demandId} AND supplement_status='WAITING_ANALYSIS' ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET initial_status='SENDING', initial_lease_token=#{leaseToken}, initial_lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, initial_attempt_count=initial_attempt_count+1, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND initial_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','SENDING') AND (initial_status != 'SENDING' OR initial_lease_until <= #{now})

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET initial_status='SENT', initial_sent_at=#{sentAt}, initial_error=NULL, initial_lease_token=NULL, initial_lease_until=NULL, episode_suppressed_until=#{suppressedUntil}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND initial_status='SENDING' AND initial_lease_token=#{leaseToken}

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET initial_status='RETRY', initial_next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, initial_error=#{error}, initial_lease_token=NULL, initial_lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND initial_status='SENDING' AND initial_lease_token=#{leaseToken}

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET initial_status='DEAD_LETTER', initial_error=#{error}, open_episode_key=NULL, initial_lease_token=NULL, initial_lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND initial_lease_token=#{leaseToken}
UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET analysis_demand_id=#{demandId}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND supplement_status='WAITING_ANALYSIS'

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET supplement_status='READY', supplement_analysis_id=#{analysisId}, supplement_subject=#{subject}, supplement_body=#{body}, supplement_next_attempt_at=NULL, supplement_error=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND analysis_demand_id=#{demandId} AND supplement_status='WAITING_ANALYSIS'

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET supplement_status='SENDING', supplement_lease_token=#{leaseToken}, supplement_lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, supplement_attempt_count=supplement_attempt_count+1, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND supplement_status IN ('READY','RETRY','SENDING') AND (supplement_status != 'SENDING' OR supplement_lease_until <= #{now})

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET supplement_status='SENT', supplement_sent_at=#{sentAt}, supplement_error=NULL, supplement_lease_token=NULL, supplement_lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND supplement_status='SENDING' AND supplement_lease_token=#{leaseToken}

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET supplement_status='RETRY', supplement_next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, supplement_error=#{error}, supplement_lease_token=NULL, supplement_lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND supplement_status='SENDING' AND supplement_lease_token=#{leaseToken}

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET supplement_status='DEAD_LETTER', supplement_error=#{error}, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE analysis_demand_id=#{demandId} AND supplement_status IN ('WAITING_ANALYSIS','READY','RETRY','SENDING')

UPDATE stock_watch_alert_delivery_obligation SET supplement_status='DEAD_LETTER', supplement_error=#{error}, supplement_lease_token=NULL, supplement_lease_until=NULL, row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND supplement_lease_token=#{leaseToken}
